details: Preserve the approved baseline exactly, including both AC/38 cannons, all chassis geometry, materials, pose, framing and shoulder pod outer housings. Change only the mech-own left shoulder insert (image-right) to a recessed ARC laser optical emitter, removing its launcher apertures. Keep the mech-own right shoulder (image-left) original NEEDLE/2 launcher unchanged. No glow, beams, new housings or added weapons.
